game: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Battle in the Sewer

sections.Profile:
Fight through the streets and sewers of New York as Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello or Michelangelo, completing Turtle Training objectives and taking on Bebop and Rocksteady before a final battle with Shredder. A home-size licensed game from Wonderland Amusements, with artwork by TMNT comic artist Mateus Santolouco.
